description:
Responsibilities 
 

 Building out the front-end for the websites for the TV shows and movies that our client produces. 
 Build reusable code and libraries for future use 
 Develop and maintain user-facing features 
 Optimize application for maximum speed and scalability 
 This will be a 100% hands on development opportunity, and you will spend 100% of the time on the front-end. 
 Requirements 
 

 3+ years of hands on software development experience on the front-end 
 Experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript 
 Experience with the JavaScript framework; Angular.JS2 
 Have an eye for good design and user experience, and are able to implement designs from product managers and designers. 
 Pluses 
 

 Experience integrating with API’s on the backend 
 Experience with Bootstrap 
 Experience with Jasmine 
 Experience with Typescript

  HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Angular.JS

 Only W2
